title: Braindrain Cape

sources.title: Mental Debilitation
markers: | description = When the wearer succeeds a {{Saving Throw}} against any foe's spells or actions, that foe gains {{Cond|Mental Fatigue}}.

summary: Succeed on a save against a foe’s spell or action to give that foe Mental Fatigue for 2 turns. Mental Fatigue penalizes Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves by 1 per turn remaining. Failing such a save at 5+ turns deals 1d4 Psychic and removes the condition.
